ev.q: Six cases of RMSF caused by Rickettsia rickettsii , including three deaths, were reported
This outbreak of severe and fatal RMSF after exposures in Tecate, Mexico
six cases of RMSF in persons with exposure in Tecate, Mexico

methods_quotes.q: Additional cases were identified retrospectively through inquiries to local border county hospitals
Interviews with surviving patients or their family members revealed that each patient had traveled to or lived in Tecate, Mexico
